reviews.rationale: The inspected source is only a relabelling of one kg of primary aluminium ingot into the wrought-alloy market. Its three positive primary-ingot purchases sum to one kg; it contains no alloying, forming or secondary-metal operation. Use complete native primary aluminium per signed nominal kg, rather than a whole wrought-alloy production mix.
limitations: Replace the three source primary-ingot regional shares with complete European native primary aluminium as an explicit screening proxy. Source shares, upstream electricity, liquid-metal production, casting, geography, vintage, allocation, internal uncertainty and delivery are replaced, not claimed preserved. Source metal grade and functional performance are not established as equivalent; score differences remain unquantified.

Native primary aluminium includes upstream liquid metal and casting. Do not add a second liquid-metal, alloying, sheet-rolling or casting service. Do not introduce recycled metal, recovery credits or a whole wrought-alloy production mix merely because the relabelled reference product says wrought alloy.

Preserve signed caller kg, formulas and supported uncertainty with factor +1. No new helper, foreground omission, native-inventory edit or runtime/generator Python change. The BAFU reimport has documented excluded biosphere flows.
Authorize only the inspected ecoinvent 3.8 cut-off source and UVEK 2025/native 2026 route. All other source releases remain unresolved. No inverse or cross-system-model conversion is authorized.
